messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
அப்பொழுது நீ திருப்தியுள்ளவர்களை காண்பாய் நெருப்பில் அவர்கள் வர விரும்புகிறார்கள் எப்போது அது புனிதமான மக்களுக்காக இருக்கும்.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Tamil → English) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|-------------------------------------|--------| | e | conjunction introducing a sequential action (“then”) | **அப்பொழுது** | “then / at that time” | OK | | vederai | future 2nd sg. verb “you will see” | **காண்பாய்** | “you will see” | OK | | color | demonstrative plural “those (people)” | **திருப்தியுள்ளவர்களை** | “the contented ones (ACC)” | OK | | che (rel.) | relative pronoun “who” | *(omitted)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | son | copular verb “are” | *(omitted)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | contenti | predicate adjective “contented” | **திருப்தியுள்ள** | “contented” | OK | | nel | locative preposition+article “in the” | **நெருப்பில்** | “in the fire” | OK | | foco | noun “fire” | **நெருப்பு** | “fire” | OK | | perché | causal conjunction “because” | *(omitted – resultative structure kept)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | speran | present 3rd pl. verb “they hope” | **விரும்புகிறார்கள்** | “they hope / want” | OK | | di | infinitive marker “to” | *(omitted)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | venire | infinitive “to come” | **வர** | “to come” | OK | | quando | temporal adverb “whenever” | **எப்போது** | “when / whenever” | OK | | che (particle) | particle in idiom “quando che” (reinforces temporality) | *(omitted)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | sia | subjunctive “may be” | **இருக்கும்** | “be / will be” | **GRAMMAR** (subjunctive nuance lost) | | a | preposition “to / for” (direction) | **க்காக** | “for / toward” | OK | | le | definite article, feminine plural “the” | *(omitted)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | beate | adjective “blessed” | **புனிதமான** | “blessed / holy” | OK | | genti | noun “folk, people” | **மக்கள்** | “people” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *che* (rel.), *son*, *perché*, *di*, *che* (particle), *le* – these function words have no direct lexical counterpart in Tamil and are naturally omitted. - **GRAMMAR**: *sia* – rendered with the indicative **இருக்கும்** instead of a subjunctive‑like form; Tamil lacks a true subjunctive, but the nuance of “may be” is not fully captured. - No **MISSING** or **WRONG** lexical items; all content words are represented.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 118: - Original: அப்பொழுது நீ திருப்தியுள்ளவர்களை காண்பாய் - Issue: none - Corrected: அப்பொழுது நீ திருப்தியுள்ளவர்களை காண்பாய்
- Line 119: - Original: நெருப்பில் அவர்கள் வர விரும்புகிறார்கள் - Issue: none - Corrected: நெருப்பில் அவர்கள் வர விரும்புகிறார்கள்
- Line 120: - Original: எப்போது அது புனிதமான மக்களுக்காக இருக்கும். - Issue: GRAMMAR – the verb does not convey the potential/subjunctive sense of “may be”. - Corrected: எப்போது அது புனிதமான மக்களுக்காக இருந்தாலும்.
